reason: This is primarily an automation plugin for DeepSeek Harness that introduces a user-selectable managed approval preset to reduce manual prompts by reviewing certain tool calls automatically. It combines risk-based MCP classification, configurable tool rules, and one-shot grants with native fallbacks to human approval when reviewer outcomes are missing or failing, so it changes permission workflow rather than adding core content editing or data-processing features.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 增加“Approve for me”会话级权限预设，在侧重风险的策略下对部分工具调用进行一次性自动审批，并在审核失败时回退到原生人工确认。
summaries.en: This plugin adds an "Approve for me" session preset to DeepSeek Harness, applying one-time, rule and risk-based review to selected tool calls and deferring to the native human approval flow when automated review is not available.

capabilities: Automates approval handling by adding a managed permission preset
Performs risk-based routing of MCP tool calls into reviewer flow
Enforces one-time tool execution grants and configurable allow/review/deny rules
Falls back to native human approval on reviewer failures
